label: Wallpaper
description: A phone or desktop wallpaper: one subject, a lot of deliberate emptiness, and nothing important where the clock and the icons land.
prefix: A wallpaper composition, one calm subject with generous empty space around it
suffix: composed for a screen: the subject held low or to one side, a broad quiet field of negative space where icons and a clock would sit, no detail that fights small text, flawless clean edges
negative: text, logo, watermark, busy foreground clutter, centred subject filling the frame, watermark, signature, text artifacts, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers
